patterns.note: Full-bleed sections with distinct, often animated or illustrated, background imagery (space, Mars landscapes) create an immersive, continuous visual narrative.
Primary headings use an extremely large, bold, and blocky display typeface, often in bright red or white, creating a strong, impactful visual hierarchy.
A vibrant and high-contrast palette combines deep space blues/blacks with fiery oranges and reds, accented by bright yellows and whites, evoking a futuristic, energetic feel.

As the user scrolls, the initial hero illustration (car and moon) scrolls up and out of view, revealing a large, detailed astronaut character sitting on the Mars landscape, creating a layered reveal effect. Sticky side panels remain fixed in the viewport.
Each major content section is themed as a distinct part of the 'Dogelon Universe,' featuring custom illustrations and unique background environments that reinforce the brand's narrative.

technique_notes: The hero section utilizes a full-bleed animated canvas or video background to create a dynamic, immersive space environment, over which large, bold text and a prominent call-to-action are overlaid.

Scroll-triggered motion is used to create a layered reveal effect: initial hero elements scroll away at a faster rate, while a large, detailed character illustration is revealed from below, appearing to sit on the persistent background. Sticky side navigation elements maintain their position throughout the scroll.

Custom illustrations and character designs are integrated throughout the site, often animated using CSS keyframes, to bring the brand's narrative to life and create a playful, engaging user experience.

design_tokens.type_scale: Extremely oversized, bold, and blocky display headings (~5-6x body text) create a powerful visual impact, contrasted with smaller, legible sans-serif body text.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounding on buttons and card elements, but many key visual elements and headings maintain sharp, angular edges.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced to airy, with generous vertical spacing between major sections and a more dense, but still clear, layout for card grids and data displays.

standout: This site's design is distinctive for its highly stylized, cartoonish space/Mars theme, brought to life with custom, high-quality illustrations and dynamic animations. The bold, blocky typography, combined with a vibrant, high-contrast color palette, creates an energetic and playful brand identity that feels more like an interactive game than a typical crypto project, setting it apart from generic marketing templates.
